title: Log Rack Cover with Window and Vent – Protection Against Debris
seo_title: Log Rack Cover with Window – 122 × 61 × 106 cm
seo_description: Log rack cover in black fabric, 122 × 61 × 106 cm, with a window, air vent and opening on the front. See the wood and reach it without lifting off the cover.
descriptionHtml:
Never knowing how much firewood is left

The log rack stands outside in all weather, and to see how much is left you have to step out, lift the tarp and feel the cold hit you – every time, even if it was only to check.

A cover you can see through

The cover in black fabric covers the whole log rack, 122 × 61 × 106 cm, with a window that has an air vent and an opening on the front. You can see how much firewood is left without lifting the cover, air circulates through the vent, and the wood is reached through the opening that rolls up. The log rack is not included, only the cover.

Features

  • Leaves and debris are kept off the firewood – the cover covers the whole log rack, 122 × 61 × 106 cm.
  • See how much firewood is left without lifting the cover – the window in the cover lets you peek in.
  • Air circulates without opening the cover – the air vent in the window lets air through.
  • The wood is reachable without lifting off the cover – the opening on the front rolls up.
  • Fits log racks up to 122 × 61 × 106 cm – the cover's dimensions are set for that size.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
